comments: I found a cockroach in my bedroom but other than that I’d say this room is good for 1 person only, it’s small and the bathroom is small aswell. This is okay to stay for 1 night or 2. Cars make noise very late at night across the street from you and is loud to sleep.

If you are ever in Toronto you must stay here! Absolutely unparrelled views of the CN Tower and entertainment district and great flat (stylish, well decorated and more than functional). Lifts got a bit annoying as they often took ages to arrive but absolutely nothing that the host could have done about it and Idrees was a fantastic host- super quick and responsive. Would fully recommend!

Great place to stay at. The apartment was a lot bigger than I expected and I loved how the hosts included amenities you would only get at a hotel. The WiFi connection was great; we were able to stream without any issues. Bed was comfy and extra blankets were provided.  The location was perfect!  A convenience store and a Tim Hortons at your doorstep; the subway was about 2 blocks away which was perfect for getting around. The hosts were already very quick to respond whenever I had a question. All around great deal.

The location was perfect for seeing our family. The room is a studio, so it is small and its perfect for crashing and relaxing. Lots of information from the host as to things to do! We were there to see family, so the agenda was full. There are 3 sets of locks to get in, this is good on one hand challenging when carrying luggage in.
The biggest negative was not having a way to know about the party going on in the room down the hall till 2am, so while it says private room. Its a converted hotel, and very cool! Yet we didnt know about the other rooms being allowed to party till the early morning.
I would stay again.
Bob
Really great host. Didn’t really have much issues. Whenever I needed to ask anything he responded promptly.

The townhouse is in great location for access to Toronto, bars and restaurants and public transport. Would recommend for a couple.
Can be a bit noisy with the apartment above but if you are out seeing Toronto you won’t be home to notice.

Quiet, very clean place, very comfortable bed, and well-appointed bathroom. Keep in mind that's the extent of the space. The wifi was so-so, but acceptable. Beth was considerate and prompt in responding, and there were no problems checking in. The location was good for us, though parking can be a bit of a problem throughout that neighbourhood.

Alisa's place was nice. King St is a bit busy but the apartment is very quiet. The place was decently equiped. Small stuff could be addressed that were somewhat inconvenient like small TV, small trash cans, and lack of a nightstand. I'm sure they'll be addressed.

We had a pleasant stay in Daniel's apartment. The flat is located in a quiet neighborhood close to a busier street with streetcar lines, restaurants and shops. It is very spacious and well equipped, only the kitchen is bit worn out. Downtown can be reached by public transport in around 45-60 minutes. Daniel is a really nice and communicative host.
